title: Randomized-base GT transfer with a revised STNFS core (99.9% main-phase ECM, theta 207/500, direct record scatter, unit-entry LA with combined row tail): 125.0815

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm in proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound (1-2^-128) x 0.391949 - 2^-48), conditional on the disclosed H1-H5 (with H4u) of source-core.md. It maps the problem to GT by z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, which gives exactly the uniform (nonidentity base, independent target) input distribution, converts both into the STNFS tower by the explicit charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is the recover-Q core of submission e3940d11 with the main-phase revision of REVISION.md: 99.9% per-prime main-phase ECM (403 curves per side), relation sub-region theta=207/500, cofactor slacks (300, 228), relation records routed by direct chunk scatter at 21 instructions per record, sparse matrix entries at 44 instructions (11-instruction +-1 loop, combined row tail; unit share >= 0.88, heuristic H4u) with block Wiedemann (18, 4), canonical-work allowance 1.0593 (>= 1 + 2.00 incidence-inclusive SE), descent missing-log inputs 747.5/498.9 with the unchanged plan, two-log meter 2^118.635; its upper-rounded complete ledger is below 2^121.7452 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000) with success at least 0.391949. Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x (101/100) x 2^121.7452 + 2^80/2000 < 2^125.0815 G1 reference units (C=2,000); the 101/100 is a reserve on the whole core instruction ledger. Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Fast run (input {}): recomputes the theta=207/500 region, certified count products, yield and margin, incidence-inclusive work SE and allowance, 99.9% ECM schedules, the LA kernel counts in la_mac.s and the 44-instruction entry price, linear algebra, success and the full ledger with the declared descent rows, then the G1 conversion and finite bijections. {"descent": true} also reruns the complete descent recurrence, node-counter and repeat terms (about 10 s). {"unit_entries": [k, seed]} measures the H4u unit share at scale 2^k (k <= 15 within the limit).
